name: ideatovideo-runner
description: The runner's own dependencies, bundled with the app (tauri.conf.json resources). The official Anthropic SDK for the native Claude connector (DECISIONS 89), and the free local voice (DECISIONS 133): the ONNX runtime for the Kokoro model and the CMU pronouncing dictionary. Every other provider goes through plain fetch. onnxruntime-node stays at 1.22.0: newer versions crash on Windows 11 (measured 2026-11-02).
